messages.text:
I can’t add the delivery charge to the item refund or label it as the item’s price. Shipping isn’t included in item refunds, and the item refund is limited to the amount paid for the rack (refund-policy/v2/amount; refund-policy/v2/shipping).

I’ve proposed **BRL 119.00** for the returned metal rack only. Confirm the exact proposal with the button on its card; typing “yes” here won’t confirm it (refund-policy/v2/approval). If you still want the delivery charge reviewed, that requires a staff member (refund-policy/v2/shipping; refund-policy/v2/exceptions).
